base.text: Except as otherwise provided in this Chapter: No person shall stand or park a vehicle in a roadway other than parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.

potential_exception.text: The City Traffic Engineer shall determine upon what streets angle parking shall be permitted, and shall provide signage or other markings to indicate where such parking is permitted. Where angle parking is permitted, no person shall stand or park a vehicle unless the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement.
site_conditions_to_acquire: City Traffic Engineer permission for the exact street
signage or markings indicating where angle parking is permitted
original vehicle front direction during standing or parking

review_scope: exported law inventory only; not complete Chapter review
